about: Expected answers of the Process4 tool to the 150 recorded changes of the notice's proof, converted to the Process4 forms in this folder, under the owner's decision C of 25 November 2026 (design part 2, section 7; build text 5, section 6): what changed is each item's means, worked out by the tool from the code; who is told is a lookup in the later modules' uses files, and a place outside the standard, or a module with no uses file, hears of any change to the files of a module it may refer to.

For each change: told, each told module with, briefly, its reasons (provider, item and the parts of its means that changed, and how it was found where not by its means; or provider and "a place outside the standard", "an order fault" or "no uses file"); refuses, the modules from the provider on whose check refuses after the change.

The uses files are written for the product before each change by the stand-in writer, tool/test/usesfile-standin.mjs, until the tool's own writer is in the tool; a merge rewrites no other module's uses file, so the product after the change holds the same ones.

A change's `meaning` (in its change.json, { item, line }) stands for the meaning entries ARCH places in waiting work: given to the 17 changes whose titles state a new value or meaning as their aim (study-changes.md, section 2.7).

needs is the proof's reading of which users truly needed a change, with the 13 breaks found by running each later module's own tests before and after each change added (process/research/uses-metadata-25nov/proof.md, section 1.3).
Each answer that differs from design 8's (the listing and inferred uses) has one line in rerecorded saying why; design 8's own lines are in the history of this file.
